install.title: Install tracking
install.subtitle: Add this one line to every page, right before the closing {tag} tag. It loads in the background, is under 5 KB, and never records what people type.
install.status.waitingHelp: Open your site in another tab once the line is live. We detect the first visit within seconds.
install.trouble.title: Still waiting?
install.trouble.1: Make sure the line is on the live site, not only in a preview or staging copy.
install.trouble.2: Clear any cache plugin or CDN cache (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, Cloudflare) after adding it.
install.trouble.3: Testing from another address? Add it under “Also accept data from” below.
install.trouble.4: Ad blockers can hide your own visits. Try a private window or your phone.
install.guide.html.1: Open your site's HTML template (usually index.html or a shared header file).
install.guide.html.2: Paste the line right before the closing {tag} tag.
install.guide.wordpress.1: Install the free WPCode plugin (Plugins → Add New → search “WPCode”).
install.guide.wordpress.2: Go to Code Snippets → Header & Footer and paste the line into the Header box.
install.guide.wordpress.3: Save, clear your cache plugin, then open your site.
install.guide.shopify.1: In Shopify admin, open Online Store → Themes → … → Edit code.
install.guide.shopify.2: Open layout/theme.liquid and paste the line right before {tag}.
install.guide.react.1: Open index.html in your project root.
install.guide.nextjs.1: In your root layout, import Script from next/script.
install.guide.nextjs.2: Add the same src and data-site as a Script component with strategy “afterInteractive”.
install.guide.telegram_mini_app.1: Open the HTML page your Mini App loads (the URL you registered with @BotFather).
install.guide.telegram_mini_app.3: Open the Mini App from Telegram. Visits are tagged as Mini App automatically.
install.guide.other.1: Find the template that renders the head section of every page.
